title: China-to-Uzbekistan Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: Electrical Safety and National O'zDST Certification
rows.target_requirement: Uzbekistan power tools are handled through the national conformity regime administered by Uzstandart and the national technical-regulation system, using O'zDST standards that are often adopted from GOST IEC power-tool safety standards such as IEC 60745 or IEC 62841. Regulated goods may require national certification or declaration before sale, with national-language labelling. The electrical supply is 220/380 V, 50 Hz, which genuinely matches China's 220/380 V nominal grid.
target_standards: Uzbekistan national mandatory certification or declaration regime for regulated goods
O'zDST standards, including GOST IEC-adopted IEC 60745 or IEC 62841 power-tool safety standards where listed
National-language labelling requirements
Uzbekistan grid: 220/380 V, 50 Hz
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool files commonly use GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 safety standards, GB 4343 EMC evidence, and CCC where the China domestic category is in scope. The voltage/frequency baseline is close because China is also 220/380 V nominal at 50 Hz, but China reports and CCC certificates do not replace Uzbekistan national certification or declaration.
china_standards: CCC where applicable to the China domestic market
rows.gap: The technical voltage match reduces redesign risk, but it is not a market-access approval. Exporters still need to map GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 evidence to the Uzbekistan O'zDST or GOST IEC-adopted standard used by the certification body, confirm whether the exact product is regulated, and prepare Uzbek or Russian national-language marking and instructions.

target.en: Mandatory where the power tool is a regulated good under Uzbekistan's national conformity list; O'zDST or adopted GOST IEC testing and national certification or declaration may be required before sale.
target.zh: 当电动工具属于乌兹别克斯坦国家合格评定目录列管商品时强制；销售前可能需要 O'zDST 或采标 GOST IEC 测试以及国家认证或声明。
target.zht: 當電動工具屬於烏茲別克斯坦國家合格評定目錄列管商品時強制；銷售前可能需要 O'zDST 或採標 GOST IEC 測試以及國家認證或聲明。

cn.en: China domestic baseline commonly uses GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 and CCC where applicable, plus GB 4343 EMC evidence.
cn.zh: 中国境内基线通常采用 GB 3883 或 GB/T 3883，并在适用时采用 CCC，另有 GB 4343 EMC 证据。
cn.zht: 中國境內基線通常採用 GB 3883 或 GB/T 3883，並在適用時採用 CCC，另有 GB 4343 EMC 證據。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Uzbekistan-ready on China GB or CCC evidence alone; use the voltage match as an engineering advantage, then obtain the required national O'zDST or GOST IEC-based conformity evidence and local-language labelling.

source.publisher: Uzstandart / Uzbekistan national standardization and technical regulation authority

rows.target_requirement: Uzbekistan EMC conformity for power tools should be handled through the national conformity regime and applicable O'zDST or adopted GOST IEC/CISPR standards. Cordless tools without radio are still assessed for electrical EMC where regulated. If a tool, charger, battery pack, or accessory includes Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, cellular, or other radio transmission, radio approval is handled by the national communications authority rather than by EAEU TR CU rules.
target_standards: Uzbekistan national conformity assessment for EMC where regulated
O'zDST or adopted GOST IEC/CISPR EMC standards for household appliances, motor-operated tools, and similar apparatus
National communications authority approval for radio transmitting equipment
rows.china_equivalent: China export files commonly include GB 4343 EMC reports for motor-operated tools, GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 safety reports, and CCC where applicable. Wireless modules may also have China radio evidence, but those documents do not substitute for Uzbekistan national EMC conformity or national radio approval.
china_standards: CCC where applicable to the China domestic market
China radio approval evidence where radio modules are present
rows.gap: The main gap is assuming a China EMC report or an EAEU EMC certificate is portable into Uzbekistan. Uzbekistan is an EAEU observer only, so the target file should identify the national O'zDST or adopted GOST EMC route and add separate national communications approval for any radio transmitter.

target.en: Mandatory where the product is listed for national EMC conformity assessment; radio approval is mandatory where the product contains an intentional transmitter.
target.zh: 当产品列入国家 EMC 合格评定范围时强制；产品含有有意发射无线电设备时，无线电核准强制。
target.zht: 當產品列入國家 EMC 合格評定範圍時強制；產品含有有意發射無線電設備時，無線電核准強制。

cn.en: China domestic evidence commonly uses GB 4343 EMC standards, GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 safety evidence, and CCC where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国境内证据通常采用 GB 4343 EMC 标准、GB 3883 或 GB/T 3883 安全证据，并在适用时采用 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內證據通常採用 GB 4343 EMC 標準、GB 3883 或 GB/T 3883 安全證據，並在適用時採用 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Build a Uzbekistan-specific EMC and radio file; China GB 4343 evidence can support comparison, but national O'zDST or adopted GOST EMC conformity and radio approval remain separate target-market steps.

source.publisher: Ministry of Digital Technologies of the Republic of Uzbekistan

rows.requirement: Market Access, EAEU Observer Status, and Logistics
rows.target_requirement: Uzbekistan is an EAEU observer, not an EAEU member bound by TR CU or TR EAEU technical regulations. Power-tool market access should therefore be screened under Uzbekistan national mandatory certification or declaration lists, O'zDST standards, customs practice, national-language labelling, and any radio approval. Uzbekistan is landlocked; typical freight planning uses rail and road corridors via Kazakhstan, Russia, or China rather than seaport import directly into Uzbekistan.
target_standards: Uzbekistan national mandatory certification or declaration list
O'zDST standards and national technical regulations
National-language labelling and importer documentation
National radio approval where radio modules are present
Landlocked logistics via Kazakhstan, Russia, or China rail and road corridors
rows.china_equivalent: China domestic compliance evidence usually includes GB 3883 or GB/T 3883, GB 4343 EMC, and CCC where applicable. These records may help the Uzbekistan importer prepare the technical file, but they do not create TR CU, TR EAEU, or Uzbekistan national market access by themselves.
china_standards: CCC where applicable to the China domestic market
China export commercial and customs documentation
rows.gap: The common planning error is treating Uzbekistan as if EAEU TR CU certification were automatically required or sufficient. The honest route is national Uzbekistan conformity assessment, local-language labelling, importer and customs preparation, and landlocked corridor planning.

target.en: National certification or declaration is mandatory where listed by Uzbekistan; TR CU and TR EAEU technical regulations are not binding merely because Uzbekistan is an EAEU observer.
target.zh: 当乌兹别克斯坦目录列管时，国家认证或声明强制；乌兹别克斯坦只是 EAEU 观察员，因此 TR CU 和 TR EAEU 技术法规并不当然具有约束力。
target.zht: 當烏茲別克斯坦目錄列管時，國家認證或聲明強制；烏茲別克斯坦只是 EAEU 觀察員，因此 TR CU 和 TR EAEU 技術法規並不當然具有約束力。

cn.en: China domestic baseline is not a Uzbekistan market-access approval; CCC applies only where relevant to China domestic placement.
cn.zh: 中国境内基线不是乌兹别克斯坦市场准入批准；CCC 仅在中国国内投放适用时适用。
cn.zht: 中國境內基線不是烏茲別克斯坦市場准入批准；CCC 僅在中國國內投放適用時適用。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Use a Uzbekistan national route, not an EAEU shortcut; confirm the mandatory certification or declaration list, local labelling, radio approval if any, and rail or road import route before shipment.

rows.target_requirement: Uzbekistan does not use the EU outdoor-noise directive model as a product market-access regime for power tools. Noise information may be relevant under national occupational health, workplace safety, sanitary, or user-instruction practice, but there is no EU-style guaranteed sound-power marking route equivalent to Directive 2000/14/EC for placing ordinary power tools on the Uzbekistan market.
target_standards: Uzbekistan national occupational health and workplace safety practice
No EU Directive 2000/14/EC-style outdoor-noise conformity marking as a general product placement requirement
Noise data in instructions where required by the applicable O'zDST or adopted GOST IEC power-tool standard
rows.china_equivalent: China GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 tool files may include noise test information or instruction-manual warnings, while GB 4343 covers EMC and not acoustic emissions. That information can support user documentation, but it is not an Uzbekistan outdoor-noise market-access mark.
china_standards: China workplace or instruction-manual noise information where applicable
GB 4343 EMC baseline, not an acoustic-emission standard
rows.gap: There is no EU-style outdoor-noise marking gap to close. The practical gap is making sure noise values, warnings, PPE instructions, and safe-use information required by the applicable O'zDST or adopted GOST IEC tool standard are translated and aligned with national-language documentation.

target.en: No general mandatory EU-style outdoor-noise marking regime for power-tool placement; national OHS, sanitary, workplace, and tool-standard instruction requirements may still apply.
target.zh: 不存在针对电动工具投放的一般强制欧盟式户外噪声标识制度；国家职业健康、卫生、工作场所及工具标准说明书要求仍可能适用。
target.zht: 不存在針對電動工具投放的一般強制歐盟式戶外噪聲標識制度；國家職業健康、衛生、工作場所及工具標準說明書要求仍可能適用。

cn.en: China GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 noise information is commonly an instruction and safety-data matter, not a Uzbekistan market-access marking approval.
cn.zh: 中国 GB 3883 或 GB/T 3883 噪声信息通常属于说明书和安全数据事项，不是乌兹别克斯坦市场准入标识批准。
cn.zht: 中國 GB 3883 或 GB/T 3883 噪聲資訊通常屬於說明書和安全數據事項，不是烏茲別克斯坦市場准入標識批准。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not present EU outdoor-noise marking as an Uzbekistan requirement; instead, maintain translated noise, PPE, and safe-use information required by the applicable national or adopted GOST IEC tool standard.

source.publisher: Uzstandart / Uzbekistan national standardization and technical regulation authority

rows.requirement: Restricted Substances and No Horizontal RoHS
rows.target_requirement: Uzbekistan does not have a horizontal EU-style RoHS or binding EAEU RoHS regime for power tools. TR EAEU 037/2016 does not apply in Uzbekistan because Uzbekistan is an EAEU observer only, not a member bound by TR EAEU technical regulations. Substance controls may still arise from product-specific, customs, waste, battery, or customer-contract requirements, but they should not be described as Uzbekistan RoHS unless a specific national legal basis is identified.
target_standards: No horizontal Uzbekistan RoHS regime identified for ordinary power tools
TR EAEU 037/2016 does not apply in Uzbekistan as binding market law
Product-specific, customs, waste, battery, or contract substance controls where separately applicable
rows.china_equivalent: China files may include China RoHS declarations, GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 safety evidence, GB 4343 EMC evidence, and CCC where applicable. China RoHS declarations can be useful customer evidence, but they do not prove an Uzbekistan horizontal RoHS obligation because that obligation is not the target-market baseline.
china_standards: China RoHS material declarations where prepared
CCC where applicable to the China domestic market
rows.gap: The gap is over-claiming: do not copy an EU RoHS or EAEU TR EAEU 037/2016 row into the Uzbekistan target column. Keep material declarations for customers and due diligence, but state plainly that no horizontal Uzbekistan RoHS or EAEU RoHS market law applies to ordinary power tools.

target.en: No horizontal mandatory RoHS regime for ordinary power tools; TR EAEU 037/2016 is not binding in Uzbekistan. Check separate product, battery, waste, customs, or contract requirements.
target.zh: 普通电动工具没有横向强制 RoHS 制度；TR EAEU 037/2016 在乌兹别克斯坦不具约束力。需另查产品、电池、废弃物、海关或合同要求。
target.zht: 普通電動工具沒有橫向強制 RoHS 制度；TR EAEU 037/2016 在烏茲別克斯坦不具約束力。需另查產品、電池、廢棄物、海關或合約要求。

cn.en: China RoHS and China GB or CCC evidence may be maintained as domestic or customer documentation, but not as proof of a Uzbekistan RoHS market-access step.
cn.zh: 中国 RoHS 与中国 GB 或 CCC 证据可作为国内或客户文件维护，但不能作为乌兹别克斯坦 RoHS 市场准入步骤的证明。
cn.zht: 中國 RoHS 與中國 GB 或 CCC 證據可作為國內或客戶文件維護，但不能作為烏茲別克斯坦 RoHS 市場准入步驟的證明。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat RoHS for Uzbekistan honestly: no horizontal EU-style or EAEU RoHS market-law step applies, so keep substance records as due diligence unless a specific Uzbekistan requirement or customer contract says otherwise.

rows.target_requirement: Cordless power tools should be assessed at both tool and battery-pack level. Uzbekistan battery safety evidence is commonly mapped to O'zDST or adopted GOST IEC versions of IEC 62133 for portable sealed rechargeable cells and batteries, plus transport documentation for lithium batteries. This is a national conformity and safety-documentation issue, not an EU Battery Regulation or EAEU RoHS obligation.
target_standards: O'zDST or adopted GOST IEC 62133 battery safety standard where accepted by the national conformity route
Lithium-battery transport documentation for rail, road, air, or multimodal shipment
Tool-level O'zDST or adopted GOST IEC 60745 / 62841 safety evidence
National-language battery marking and user instructions
rows.china_equivalent: China cordless-tool files may include GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 tool safety, GB 4343 EMC, CCC where applicable, and lithium-battery safety or transport records. Those records should be mapped model-by-model to the Uzbekistan O'zDST or adopted GOST IEC 62133 route and to lithium transport requirements for the chosen corridor.
china_standards: CCC where applicable to the China domestic market
China lithium-battery safety and transport records
rows.gap: Frequent gaps are bundling the battery pack into the tool file without a separate battery standard mapping, omitting lithium transport paperwork for landlocked rail or road routes, and copying EU Battery Regulation wording even though Uzbekistan should be handled under national and logistics requirements.

target.en: Battery safety evidence is required where the battery pack is part of the regulated product or requested by the national conformity body; lithium transport documents are required by the selected transport mode and route.
target.zh: 当电池包属于列管产品组成部分或国家合格评定机构要求时，需要电池安全证据；锂电运输文件由所选运输方式和路线要求。
target.zht: 當電池包屬於列管產品組成部分或國家合格評定機構要求時，需要電池安全證據；鋰電運輸文件由所選運輸方式和路線要求。

cn.en: China battery and tool records support technical comparison but do not replace Uzbekistan O'zDST or adopted GOST IEC battery mapping or lithium logistics documents.
cn.zh: 中国电池和工具记录可支持技术对照，但不能替代乌兹别克斯坦 O'zDST 或采标 GOST IEC 电池映射及锂电物流文件。
cn.zht: 中國電池和工具記錄可支援技術對照，但不能替代烏茲別克斯坦 O'zDST 或採標 GOST IEC 電池映射及鋰電物流文件。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] For cordless tools, add a separate battery-pack file mapped to O'zDST or adopted GOST IEC 62133 and the actual lithium transport route; do not substitute EU Battery Regulation or EAEU RoHS language for Uzbekistan national evidence.

source.publisher: Uzstandart / Uzbekistan national standardization and technical regulation authority
